subject: Finova — Decision criteria and stakeholder mapping (latency, cost, deployment, SLA)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + asks: stakeholder map & decision criteria

Hi Anita / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the clear context on your current infra and the pilot goals. Quick recap from our call and a few asks so we can align next steps:

1) Recap (quick)
- Pilot goal: validate LLM-driven customer support triage for mortgage origination (5–10k monthly conversations).
- Key constraints: security/compliance, predictable SLA for production, and economical unit costs.

2) Stakeholder mapping (asks)
- Economic buyer: please confirm who will sign on budget/commits (you mentioned Lena Park — can you confirm?).
- Legal / procurement: whom should we expect for contract and SOC2 procurement review?
- Security contact: primary point for the security questionnaire and technical walkthrough.

3) Decision criteria we discussed — please confirm targets (we'll size proposals around these):
- Latency: target p95 for live responses (short completion flows)
- Cost: target unit economics or monthly budget for baseline usage
- Deployment: preference for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployment
- SLA: uptime and support windows required for go-live

4) Proposed next steps
- You confirm stakeholders + procurement timeline (we'll loop legal and solutions).
- We'll prepare a tailored proposal comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private with estimated unit costs and lead times.
- If helpful, we can schedule a technical deep-dive w/ Rishi and Dev next week.

Attachments: Finova_Roadmap_MA.pdf (call notes you shared)

If you can confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact this week, we'll get a procurement-ready packet and SOC2 summary over to you.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + asks: stakeholder map & decision criteria

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few confirmations from our side:

- Economic buyer: Lena Park (CFO) — she'll review the budget and sign any reserved capacity commits. I'll intro her if helpful.
- Procurement/legal: procurement will own contract flow; legal will require SOC2 Type II evidence and an encryption/KMS overview. I expect procurement to loop in week of Jun 29.
- Security contact: Carlos (cc'd) is our infra/security SME and will own technical Qs.

Decision criteria (high level targets):
- Latency: p95 target ~250ms for short-turnaround responses (our user tests show high sensitivity under 300ms).
- Cost: we have a target unit-economics goal aligned to ~$2,500 / 1M tokens (rough internal number) — need to see actual estimates.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable performance, but if procurement/legal require, Private (VPC/on-prem) is on the table.
- SLA: baseline expectation is 99.9% uptime with a 24/7 critical support channel for production incidents.

We'll confirm procurement contact next week and share Lena's availability for a budget call.

—Anita
Anita Shah
Head of Product, Finova

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + asks: stakeholder map & decision criteria

Thanks Anita — that's really helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of follow-ups from our side and proposed plan: 

1) Stakeholder map (we'll use this to scope the procurement packet):
- Economic buyer: Lena Park (CFO) — Marissa will request a short budget call.
- Procurement/legal: Procurement + Legal (need SOC2 Type II, DPA, data retention policies).
- Security/infra: Carlos — technical Q&A and architecture review.

2) What we'll deliver next (by Jun 29):
- A concise Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private comparison one-pager with estimated unit economics matching your token assumptions (see attached one-pager).
- SOC2 summary + encryption/KMS overview (SOC2_summary.pdf).
- A proposed pilot plan: 2-week canary, then a 6-week pilot on Dedicated (if you choose reserved capacity) — includes success metrics (latency p95, throughput, error rate).

3) Quick ask: can you confirm approx monthly token volume for the pilot (estimate will materially affect the Dedicated sizing and cost)? Even a range (50k–200k / 1M) is fine.

Proposed next meeting: Technical deep-dive with Rishi + Dev on Tue Jul 6 at 10:00am PT. Does that work?

Attaching: redwood-hosted-dedicated-private-one-pager.pdf; SOC2_summary.pdf

Best —
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Finova prep notes (SOC2, pilot ops, lead times)

Internal note — copying details into thread for transparency.

Key operational items to prepare:
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide SOC2 Summary + most recent report under NDA. Legal may request an in-depth review; allocate 3–5 business days for condensed Q&A.
- KMS / encryption: outline our KMS options (customer-managed keys for Private, KMS integration for Dedicated/Hosted).
- Private deployment lead time: on-prem packaging + integration testing typically 6–8 weeks; VPC Private is 3–4 weeks depending on networking.
- SLA: 99.9% standard for Dedicated (enterprise plan); Hosted has best-effort tiers, but we can offer SLA with Dedicated/Reserved commits.
- Pilot ops: propose we instrument p95 latency dashboards and token cost reporting (Dev will add hooks).

Action items for us:
- Dev: prepare pilot sizing and instrumentation plan aligned to token-volume estimate.
- Marissa: schedule budget call with Lena and procurement once Anita confirms.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@finova.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final clarification: decision criteria & proposed pilot timeline

Anita / Carlos —

Thanks again and appreciate the confirmations from Anita. To make sure we're fully aligned before we prep the packet, final clarifications (please confirm):

Decision criteria (finalizable):
- Latency: target p95 <= 250ms for short completions (we'll instrument p95 and 99th during pilot).
- Cost: unit-economics target ~ $0.0025 per token (equivalent to $2,500 per 1M tokens) — we'll show how Hosted / Dedicated / Private map to this target in the proposal.
- Deployment: preference = Dedicated (reserved capacity) for go-live; Private (VPC/on-prem) remains a contingency if legal/procurement requires additional isolation.
- SLA: target 99.9% uptime with 24/7 critical escalation for production; support SLAs and response times to be included in contract.

Proposed pilot plan and timing:
- Pilot start: Jul 6, 2026 — 2-week canary (low-traffic), followed by 6-week pilot on Dedicated if canary meets latency & cost gates.
- Deliverables before pilot: procurement packet (SOC2 summary, DPA, SLOs), proposal with cost estimates, pilot success criteria.

Next asks from you: confirm Lena (economic buyer) and procurement contact; confirm token-volume estimate range; confirm Jul 6 for technical kickoff.

If everything looks good, I'll: 1) schedule the budget call with Lena, 2) share the procurement packet by Jun 29, and 3) lock in the Jul 6 technical deep-dive with Rishi/Dev.

Thanks —
Marissa
